name: CoreDesignCanvas
intent: A design canvas workspace: a top toolbar over a three-panel resizable split (collapsible side panels and a dotted-grid canvas surface with a floating toolbar), including a full CanvasToolbar wired to a blueprint selector, drawing actions, and zoom tools.
when: A canvas / drawing workspace with side panels and a toolbar
The user needs blueprint selection, drawing tools, and zoom over a canvas surface
whenNot: A metrics dashboard or analytics readout -> use a Dashboard / Analytics template
A master-detail worklist -> use the Task Monitor template
A form / setup flow -> use the Project Setup template

chooseOver.because: The Design Canvas template owns the toolbar + resizable panel layout and the canvas surface with its floating toolbar.

extracted: three-panel resizable split with collapsible side panels
canvas surface with a floating toolbar
CanvasToolbar (blueprint selector + drawing actions + zoom tools)

notes: promotedFrom: apps/web example (DesignCanvasExamplePage) — reflected as a canonical Core template; the example was removed.
